name: Vault Warden
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

abilities.name: Fire Absorption
abilities.description: Whenever the warden is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.description: The warden deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warden makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Punish the Fallen.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Iron Shove (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone.

actions.name: Punish the Fallen
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet of the warden that is prone must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

generation.userConcept: a sentinel of black iron, AC 20, Huge, speed 20 feet
generation.cite: composition after Clay Golem / Stone Golem (CR 9-10)
